## Project conventions
- Keep the interface and documentation in Spanish.
- Never enable serial output by default; only document and use a hardware adapter's verified protocol.
- Do not claim that generic serial UART creates an ARINC429 electrical signal.
- Do not drive a headphone output or claim calibrated voltage output.
- Validate encoding changes with the automated tests.
